meta.homeTitle: Velyric – AI voice agents for Hungarian, German and English calls
meta.homeDescription: Velyric answers your business calls around the clock, books appointments, answers questions from your knowledge and hands over to your team when it matters.

hero.body: Answer every call, book appointments, qualify leads and support customers in Hungarian, German and English – with a voice agent that knows when to hand over to your team.

pricingPage.title: Plans that grow with your calls
pricingPage.body: Monthly plans with included voice minutes and transparent per-minute pricing beyond that.
pricingPage.canceled: Checkout was canceled. No payment was taken.
pricingPage.footnote: Prices are net amounts for the Hungarian market. VAT is added according to the applicable rules.

vat.question: Are the prices net or gross?
vat.answer: All prices are net. Invoices include VAT according to the customer's country and tax status.

overage.question: What happens when included minutes run out?
overage.answer: Calls keep working and extra minutes are billed at the plan's per-minute rate. Spending limits protect you from surprises.

change.question: Can I change plans later?
change.answer: Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately, downgrades at the end of the billing period.

numbers.question: Is a phone number included?
numbers.answer: Every plan includes at least one phone number. Carriers may require business verification before the number goes live.

productPage.title: A voice agent that works like your best receptionist
productPage.body: Velyric combines real-time voice AI with booking, knowledge, integrations and human handoff in one controlled platform.

orchestration.title: Specialist orchestration
orchestration.body: A reception agent routes each request to booking, support, sales or billing specialists with their own tool permissions.

languages.title: Three languages, one agent
languages.body: Greetings, disclosures and fallbacks are configured per language, and the agent follows the caller's language.

simulation.title: Simulation before publishing
simulation.body: Test new versions against scripted scenarios before they reach real callers.

safety.title: Guardrails
safety.body: Spending limits, tool confirmations and kill switches keep every call under control.

securityPage.title: Security and privacy by design
securityPage.body: Velyric is built so that each workspace's calls, data and credentials stay isolated and under your control.

isolation.title: Tenant isolation
isolation.body: Database row-level security separates every workspace's data at the storage layer.

secrets.title: Protected credentials
secrets.body: API keys and integration tokens are stored in a managed secret store, never shown again after creation.

disclosure.title: Transparent AI
disclosure.body: Callers always hear that they are speaking with an AI assistant.

privacy.title: Privacy controls
privacy.body: Configure retention, redact transcripts and handle data subject requests.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.body: Sensitive actions by your team, API keys and support staff are logged.

killSwitches.title: Emergency controls
killSwitches.body: Kill switches can pause tools, agents or outbound actions instantly.

docsPage.title: Velyric API
docsPage.body: Automate agents, calls, bookings and knowledge with a versioned REST API.

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.body: Create an API key under Security and send it as a bearer token. Keys are scoped to specific permissions.

conventions.title: Conventions
conventions.body: Write requests require an Idempotency-Key header. Updates use If-Match with the resource version. Lists use cursor pagination.

resources.title: Resources
resources.body: Agents, agent versions, calls, knowledge sources, services, resources, bookings and phone numbers.

errors.title: Errors and limits
errors.body: Errors return a stable code and trace ID. Rate limits are reported in RateLimit headers.
errors.example:
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 12
RateLimit: "api-key-write";r=0;t=12
